summary: A worthwhile 20–40 minute cultural pause when already around Ratchaprasong or Chit Lom. This compact, active shrine honours the four-faced Phra Phrom, the Thai representation of Brahma, outside Grand Hyatt Erawan. Expect worshippers and urban bustle rather than a spacious temple complex. Pair it with nearby shopping or a meal instead of dedicating a separate half-day.
whyGo: See a living place of devotion woven into Bangkok’s commercial centre.
The four-faced image, flower offerings and possible traditional dance offerings create a distinctive short stop; performances are devotional, with no verified visitor timetable.
bestFor: Travellers curious about contemporary Thai religious life.
A brief cultural stop on a Siam–Chit Lom shopping day.
skipIf: You want quiet gardens, extensive architecture or a long museum-style visit.
Crowding, incense or traffic noise would make a small outdoor site uncomfortable.
duration: Allow 20–40 minutes; longer if personally worshipping or observing a dance offering.
cost: Admission is free, confirmed by Tourism Authority of Thailand. Offerings and commissioned dances cost extra; current prices were not verified and buying anything is unnecessary for an observational visit.
hours: Visitor-information sites list daily 06:00–22:00, subject to on-site notices. TAT confirms daily access but supplies no usable clock times; foundation confirmation remains outstanding.
bestTime: Suggested: early morning for a cooler, less rushed visit. Late afternoon works conveniently with nearby dinner plans; allow for crowds.
gettingThere: Take BTS to Chit Lom and walk toward the Ratchaprasong intersection and Grand Hyatt Erawan. Allow roughly 5–10 minutes and follow current station/skywalk signage; online exit recommendations conflict. Prefer rail to a taxi through this busy junction.
booking: No advance admission booking needed. Do not reserve a timed visit around dancing: no dependable public schedule was found.
accessibility: The shrine is outdoors, but a complete step-free route from BTS, entrance thresholds and accessible toilets were not verified. Travellers using wheelchairs should check station lifts and street-level access before setting out.
practicalTips: Dress modestly and give worshippers space; ask before photographing people closely.
Confirm any offering price before accepting a set. Follow current rules about incense and candles.
Use marked crossings or the skywalk rather than cutting through junction traffic.
decemberNotes: For December 2026, retain this as a flexible short stop. Early mornings are a sensible comfort choice, while late-December shopping and celebrations may complicate nearby access. No December-specific shrine programme or closure was verified; check notices near your date.
uncertainties: Precise hours are supported by visitor-information websites whose operator affiliation is unclear, rather than a verified foundation notice.
December events, dance prices and schedules, and full step-free facilities remain unconfirmed.
